stemMd: Some editors are translators. Every translator speaks more than one language. Which conclusion follows necessarily?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Some editors speak more than one language.

options.label: B
options.textMd: No editor speaks only one language.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every multilingual person is an editor.

explanationMd: The editors who are translators inherit the universal property of translators: speaking more than one language. Their existence is guaranteed by “some.” No claim about all editors or about translators outside that overlap is justified.

distractorRationale.c: The first premise establishes only some overlap.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses the translator-to-multilingual implication and adds editor status.
distractorRationale.b: Editors outside the translator group may be monolingual.
distractorRationale.e: The premises do not require translators outside the overlap.
